fields.v: N/A for configurations. Agent-facing documents 60.5% of documentation interactions (instruction files 35.4%, working notes 25.1%; 55.1% agent-reweighted); classical technical documentation 10.6%, API reference 1.3%, troubleshooting 0.4%. P(edit code | read doc)=0.002; within 3 events: create doc lift 1.67 (adj. OR 1.41 [0.98, 2.02]), edit code lift 1.05 (adj. OR 1.33 [1.09, 1.62]), run test lift 0.23 (adj. OR 0.39), build 0.15 (adj. OR 0.25). Triggers: self-initiated 70.2%, user 20.4%, failure-driven 7.5%. Docs first recovery action in 5.4% of 2,034 failure episodes. Production 0.87x consultation. 41.5% of PRs change documentation; code first 4.7x more often than docs (82.5% of orderable cases). AGENTS.md (692 PRs), CLAUDE.md (362), copilot-instructions.md (287) among most-changed files. Merge rates 81.1% vs 75.0%, not distinguishable under clustering
